  (() => {
    function initSubNavbar() {
      // Change this value to control when the subnavbar appears.
      // 30 means 30% of the viewport height.
      const SHOW_AFTER_PERCENT = 30;

      const subNavbar = document.querySelector('.subnav-new');
      const navbar = document.querySelector('.nav-25_component');
      const navWrapper = document.querySelector('.nav-25_outer-wrap');

      if (!subNavbar || !navbar || !navWrapper) {

          subNavbar,
          navbar,
          navWrapper,
        });
        return;
      }

      let ticking = false;
      let isSubNavbarVisible = false;

      function setVisibility(shouldShow) {
        // Avoid unnecessary DOM updates while scrolling.
        if (shouldShow === isSubNavbarVisible) {
          return;
        }

        isSubNavbarVisible = shouldShow;

        subNavbar.classList.toggle('is-product-visible', shouldShow);

        navbar.classList.toggle('is-hidden', shouldShow);

        navWrapper.classList.toggle('is-product-visible', shouldShow);

        subNavbar.setAttribute('aria-hidden', String(!shouldShow));

        navbar.setAttribute('aria-hidden', String(shouldShow));
      }

      function updateVisibility() {
        const threshold = window.innerHeight * (SHOW_AFTER_PERCENT / 100);

        const shouldShow = window.scrollY >= threshold;

        setVisibility(shouldShow);
        ticking = false;
      }

      function requestVisibilityUpdate() {
        if (ticking) return;

        ticking = true;
        window.requestAnimationFrame(updateVisibility);
      }

      window.addEventListener('scroll', requestVisibilityUpdate, { passive: true });

      window.addEventListener('resize', requestVisibilityUpdate, { passive: true });

      // Set the correct state on initial load,
      // including refreshed pages that retain scroll position.
      updateVisibility();
    }

    }

<script>
(function () {
  var PANELS = '.nav_company_dpdown, .nav_customer-story_dpdown';
  var VIEWPORT_MARGIN = 16;

  function rem(n) {

    var toggle = item.querySelector('.nav-25_dpdown-toggle');
    if (!toggle) return;

    // The row holding the toggle — NOT .nav-25_component, which also wraps the banner.
    var row = toggle.closest('.nav-25_container')

      dpdown.dataset.navTransition = getComputedStyle(dpdown).transition || '';
    }

    dpdown.style.transition = 'none';
    dpdown.style.position = 'fixed';
    dpdown.style.transform = 'none';
    dpdown.style.width = 'max-content';
    dpdown.style.maxWidth = (document.documentElement.clientWidth - VIEWPORT_MARGIN * 2) + 'px';

    // --- targets, in viewport coordinates ---
    var t = toggle.getBoundingClientRect();
    var w = dpdown.offsetWidth;
    var targetLeft = t.left + t.width / 2 - w / 2;
    var minL = VIEWPORT_MARGIN;
    var maxL = document.documentElement.clientWidth - w - VIEWPORT_MARGIN;
    if (targetLeft > maxL) targetLeft = maxL;
    if (targetLeft < minL) targetLeft = minL;

    // Park the box to measure how far the visible card sits below it (nested
    // padding), then aim the CARD at row bottom + the designed gap.
    dpdown.style.top = '0px';
    dpdown.style.left = '0px';
    var cardOffset = panel.getBoundingClientRect().top - dpdown.getBoundingClientRect().top;
    var targetTop = row.getBoundingClientRect().bottom - cardOffset + rem(GAP_REM);

    // With a banner present, an ancestor becomes the containing block for this
    // element, so `top` resolves from ITS edge (~banner height) not the viewport.
    // Measure where the box actually landed and subtract the difference.
    dpdown.style.top = targetTop + 'px';
    dpdown.style.left = targetLeft + 'px';
    var r = dpdown.getBoundingClientRect();

    dpdown.style.transition = dpdown.dataset.navTransition;

<script>
  (() => {
    function initSubNavbar() {
      // Change this value to control when the subnavbar appears.
      // 30 means 30% of the viewport height.
      const SHOW_AFTER_PERCENT = 30;

      const subNavbar = document.querySelector('.subnav-new');
      const navbar = document.querySelector('.nav-25_component');
      const navWrapper = document.querySelector('.nav-25_outer-wrap');

      if (!subNavbar || !navbar || !navWrapper) {
        console.warn('[subnav] Required elements were not found:', {
          subNavbar,
          navbar,
          navWrapper,
        });
        return;
      }

      let ticking = false;
      let isSubNavbarVisible = false;

      function setVisibility(shouldShow) {
        // Avoid unnecessary DOM updates while scrolling.
        if (shouldShow === isSubNavbarVisible) {
          return;
        }

        isSubNavbarVisible = shouldShow;

        subNavbar.classList.toggle('is-product-visible', shouldShow);

        navbar.classList.toggle('is-hidden', shouldShow);

        navWrapper.classList.toggle('is-product-visible', shouldShow);

        subNavbar.setAttribute('aria-hidden', String(!shouldShow));

        navbar.setAttribute('aria-hidden', String(shouldShow));
      }

      function updateVisibility() {
        const threshold = window.innerHeight * (SHOW_AFTER_PERCENT / 100);

        const shouldShow = window.scrollY >= threshold;

        setVisibility(shouldShow);
        ticking = false;
      }

      function requestVisibilityUpdate() {
        if (ticking) return;

        ticking = true;
        window.requestAnimationFrame(updateVisibility);
      }

      window.addEventListener('scroll', requestVisibilityUpdate, { passive: true });

      window.addEventListener('resize', requestVisibilityUpdate, { passive: true });

      // Set the correct state on initial load,
      // including refreshed pages that retain scroll position.
      updateVisibility();
    }

    if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
      document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', initSubNavbar, { once: true });
    } else {
      initSubNavbar();
    }
  })();
</script>

<script>
(function () {
  var PANELS = '.nav_company_dpdown, .nav_customer-story_dpdown';
  var VIEWPORT_MARGIN = 16;
  var GAP_REM = 0.5; // designed gap between the nav row and the visible card

  function rem(n) {
    var root = parseFloat(getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).fontSize) || 16;
    return n * root;
  }

  function position(panel) {
    var dpdown = panel.closest('.nav-25_dpdown');
    var item = panel.closest('.nav-25_list_item');
    if (!dpdown || !item) return;
    var toggle = item.querySelector('.nav-25_dpdown-toggle');
    if (!toggle) return;

    // The row holding the toggle — NOT .nav-25_component, which also wraps the banner.
    var row = toggle.closest('.nav-25_container')
           || toggle.closest('.nav-25_middle_wrap')
           || item.closest('.nav-25_component');
    if (!row) return;

    if (dpdown.dataset.navTransition === undefined) {
      dpdown.dataset.navTransition = getComputedStyle(dpdown).transition || '';
    }

    dpdown.style.transition = 'none';
    dpdown.style.position = 'fixed';
    dpdown.style.transform = 'none';
    dpdown.style.width = 'max-content';
    dpdown.style.maxWidth = (document.documentElement.clientWidth - VIEWPORT_MARGIN * 2) + 'px';

    // --- targets, in viewport coordinates ---
    var t = toggle.getBoundingClientRect();
    var w = dpdown.offsetWidth;
    var targetLeft = t.left + t.width / 2 - w / 2;
    var minL = VIEWPORT_MARGIN;
    var maxL = document.documentElement.clientWidth - w - VIEWPORT_MARGIN;
    if (targetLeft > maxL) targetLeft = maxL;
    if (targetLeft < minL) targetLeft = minL;

    // Park the box to measure how far the visible card sits below it (nested
    // padding), then aim the CARD at row bottom + the designed gap.
    dpdown.style.top = '0px';
    dpdown.style.left = '0px';
    var cardOffset = panel.getBoundingClientRect().top - dpdown.getBoundingClientRect().top;
    var targetTop = row.getBoundingClientRect().bottom - cardOffset + rem(GAP_REM);

    // --- write, then cancel any containing-block error ---
    // With a banner present, an ancestor becomes the containing block for this
    // element, so `top` resolves from ITS edge (~banner height) not the viewport.
    // Measure where the box actually landed and subtract the difference.
    dpdown.style.top = targetTop + 'px';
    dpdown.style.left = targetLeft + 'px';
    var r = dpdown.getBoundingClientRect();
    var dy = r.top - targetTop;
    var dx = r.left - targetLeft;
    if (dy || dx) {
      dpdown.style.top = (targetTop - dy) + 'px';
      dpdown.style.left = (targetLeft - dx) + 'px';
    }

    void dpdown.offsetWidth;
    dpdown.style.transition = dpdown.dataset.navTransition;
  }

  function init() {
    // Desktop panels only — mobile panes have no .nav-25_list_item ancestor.
    var panels = [].slice.call(document.querySelectorAll(PANELS))
      .filter(function (p) { return p.closest('.nav-25_list_item'); });
    if (!panels.length) return;

    panels.forEach(function (panel) {
      panel.closest('.nav-25_list_item').addEventListener('pointerenter', function () {
        requestAnimationFrame(function () { position(panel); });
      });
    });

    window.addEventListener('resize', function () {
      panels.forEach(function (panel) { position(panel); });
    });
  }

  if (document.readyState === 'loading') document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', init);
  else init();
})();

<script>
  (() => {
    function initSubNavbar() {
      // Change this value to control when the subnavbar appears.
      // 30 means 30% of the viewport height.
      const SHOW_AFTER_PERCENT = 30;

      const subNavbar = document.querySelector('.subnav-new');
      const navbar = document.querySelector('.nav-25_component');
      const navWrapper = document.querySelector('.nav-25_outer-wrap');

      if (!subNavbar || !navbar || !navWrapper) {
        console.warn('[subnav] Required elements were not found:', {
          subNavbar,
          navbar,
          navWrapper,
        });
        return;
      }

      let ticking = false;
      let isSubNavbarVisible = false;

      function setVisibility(shouldShow) {
        // Avoid unnecessary DOM updates while scrolling.
        if (shouldShow === isSubNavbarVisible) {
          return;
        }

        isSubNavbarVisible = shouldShow;

        subNavbar.classList.toggle('is-product-visible', shouldShow);

        navbar.classList.toggle('is-hidden', shouldShow);

        navWrapper.classList.toggle('is-product-visible', shouldShow);

        subNavbar.setAttribute('aria-hidden', String(!shouldShow));

        navbar.setAttribute('aria-hidden', String(shouldShow));
      }

      function updateVisibility() {
        const threshold = window.innerHeight * (SHOW_AFTER_PERCENT / 100);

        const shouldShow = window.scrollY >= threshold;

        setVisibility(shouldShow);
        ticking = false;
      }

      function requestVisibilityUpdate() {
        if (ticking) return;

        ticking = true;
        window.requestAnimationFrame(updateVisibility);
      }

      window.addEventListener('scroll', requestVisibilityUpdate, { passive: true });

      window.addEventListener('resize', requestVisibilityUpdate, { passive: true });

      // Set the correct state on initial load,
      // including refreshed pages that retain scroll position.
      updateVisibility();
    }

    if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
      document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', initSubNavbar, { once: true });
    } else {
      initSubNavbar();
    }
  })();
</script>

<script>
(function () {
  var PANELS = '.nav_company_dpdown, .nav_customer-story_dpdown';
  var VIEWPORT_MARGIN = 16;
  var GAP_REM = 0.5; // designed gap between the nav row and the visible card

  function rem(n) {
    var root = parseFloat(getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).fontSize) || 16;
    return n * root;
  }

  function position(panel) {
    var dpdown = panel.closest('.nav-25_dpdown');
    var item = panel.closest('.nav-25_list_item');
    if (!dpdown || !item) return;
    var toggle = item.querySelector('.nav-25_dpdown-toggle');
    if (!toggle) return;

    // The row holding the toggle — NOT .nav-25_component, which also wraps the banner.
    var row = toggle.closest('.nav-25_container')
           || toggle.closest('.nav-25_middle_wrap')
           || item.closest('.nav-25_component');
    if (!row) return;

    if (dpdown.dataset.navTransition === undefined) {
      dpdown.dataset.navTransition = getComputedStyle(dpdown).transition || '';
    }

    dpdown.style.transition = 'none';
    dpdown.style.position = 'fixed';
    dpdown.style.transform = 'none';
    dpdown.style.width = 'max-content';
    dpdown.style.maxWidth = (document.documentElement.clientWidth - VIEWPORT_MARGIN * 2) + 'px';

    // --- targets, in viewport coordinates ---
    var t = toggle.getBoundingClientRect();
    var w = dpdown.offsetWidth;
    var targetLeft = t.left + t.width / 2 - w / 2;
    var minL = VIEWPORT_MARGIN;
    var maxL = document.documentElement.clientWidth - w - VIEWPORT_MARGIN;
    if (targetLeft > maxL) targetLeft = maxL;
    if (targetLeft < minL) targetLeft = minL;

    // Park the box to measure how far the visible card sits below it (nested
    // padding), then aim the CARD at row bottom + the designed gap.
    dpdown.style.top = '0px';
    dpdown.style.left = '0px';
    var cardOffset = panel.getBoundingClientRect().top - dpdown.getBoundingClientRect().top;
    var targetTop = row.getBoundingClientRect().bottom - cardOffset + rem(GAP_REM);

    // --- write, then cancel any containing-block error ---
    // With a banner present, an ancestor becomes the containing block for this
    // element, so `top` resolves from ITS edge (~banner height) not the viewport.
    // Measure where the box actually landed and subtract the difference.
    dpdown.style.top = targetTop + 'px';
    dpdown.style.left = targetLeft + 'px';
    var r = dpdown.getBoundingClientRect();
    var dy = r.top - targetTop;
    var dx = r.left - targetLeft;
    if (dy || dx) {
      dpdown.style.top = (targetTop - dy) + 'px';
      dpdown.style.left = (targetLeft - dx) + 'px';
    }

    void dpdown.offsetWidth;
    dpdown.style.transition = dpdown.dataset.navTransition;
  }

  function init() {
    // Desktop panels only — mobile panes have no .nav-25_list_item ancestor.
    var panels = [].slice.call(document.querySelectorAll(PANELS))
      .filter(function (p) { return p.closest('.nav-25_list_item'); });
    if (!panels.length) return;

    panels.forEach(function (panel) {
      panel.closest('.nav-25_list_item').addEventListener('pointerenter', function () {
        requestAnimationFrame(function () { position(panel); });
      });
    });

    window.addEventListener('resize', function () {
      panels.forEach(function (panel) { position(panel); });
    });
  }

  if (document.readyState === 'loading') document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', init);
  else init();
})();

  (function () {
    'use strict';

    const viewport = document.querySelector('.homeexp_hero-viewport');
    const track = document.querySelector('.homeexp_hero-track');
    const textEl = document.querySelector('.homeexp_hero-text');
    const cursor = document.querySelector('.homeexp_hero-cursor');
    if (!viewport || !track || !textEl || !cursor) return;

    const prompts = ['Which renewal is slipping where roadmap and reality diverged?', "What changed last week that's hitting support, sales, and churn? ", 'Where are we promising one thing, shipping another, and documenting a third?', 'Which launch blocker is buried in legal edits, release notes, and field chatter?', 'Which security issue becomes a customer problem before the account team sees it?'];

    const TYPE_MS = 55;
    const DELETE_MS = 25;
    const HOLD_TYPED_MS = 1800;
    const HOLD_EMPTY_MS = 350;
    const VARIANCE = 0.4;

    let p = 0,
      c = 0,
      phase = 'type';
    let timer = null;
    let active = true;

    const rand = (base, v) => base * (1 - v + Math.random() * 2 * v);

    function setBlink(on) {
      cursor.classList.toggle('homeexp_hero-blink', on);
    }

    function updateScroll() {
      const vw = viewport.clientWidth;
      const tw = track.scrollWidth;
      track.style.transform = tw > vw ? 'translateX(' + -(tw - vw + 4) + 'px)' : 'translateX(0)';
    }

    function tick() {
      if (!active) return;
      const current = prompts[p];
      if (phase === 'type') {
        setBlink(false);
        if (c < current.length) {
          c++;
          textEl.textContent = current.slice(0, c);
          updateScroll();
          timer = setTimeout(tick, rand(TYPE_MS, VARIANCE));
        } else {
          phase = 'hold-typed';
          setBlink(true);
          timer = setTimeout(tick, HOLD_TYPED_MS);
        }
      } else if (phase === 'hold-typed') {
        phase = 'delete';
        tick();
      } else if (phase === 'delete') {
        setBlink(false);
        if (c > 0) {
          c--;
          textEl.textContent = current.slice(0, c);
          updateScroll();
          timer = setTimeout(tick, rand(DELETE_MS, VARIANCE * 0.5));
        } else {
          phase = 'hold-empty';
          setBlink(true);
          timer = setTimeout(tick, HOLD_EMPTY_MS);
        }
      } else if (phase === 'hold-empty') {
        p = (p + 1) % prompts.length;
        phase = 'type';
        tick();
      }
    }

    if ('IntersectionObserver' in window) {
      const obs = new IntersectionObserver(
        function (entries) {
          entries.forEach(function (e) {
            if (e.isIntersecting && !active) {
              active = true;
              tick();
            } else if (!e.isIntersecting && active) {
              active = false;
              clearTimeout(timer);
            }
          });
        },
        {
          threshold: 0.05,
        },
      );
      obs.observe(viewport);
    }

    let resizeTimer;
    window.addEventListener(
      'resize',
      function () {
        clearTimeout(resizeTimer);
        resizeTimer = setTimeout(updateScroll, 100);
      },
      {
        passive: true,
      },
    );

    tick();
  })();

<script>
(() => {
  const root = document.getElementById("token-savings");
  if (!root) return;

  const numberEl = root.querySelector(".home_why_tokens_numbers");

  const TOTAL_AT_ANCHOR = Number(root.dataset.anchorTotal || 0);
  const ANCHOR_MS = Date.parse(root.dataset.anchorTime || "");
  const DAILY_RATE = Number(root.dataset.dailyRate || 0);
  const VARIANCE = Number(root.dataset.variance || 0.08);

  if (!TOTAL_AT_ANCHOR || !ANCHOR_MS || !DAILY_RATE) return;

  const BASE_PER_SEC = DAILY_RATE / 86400;
  const TAU = Math.PI * 2;

  const CYCLE_MS = 3500;
  const MIN_ANIM_MS = 900;
  const MAX_ANIM_MS = 1700;

  let currentCycle = -1;
  let columns = [];
  let currentDisplayValue = 0;

  function hash01(n) {
    const x = Math.sin(n * 12.9898 + 78.233) * 43758.5453123;
    return x - Math.floor(x);
  }

  function integratedTotal(elapsedSec) {
    const a1 = VARIANCE * 0.65;
    const a2 = VARIANCE * 0.35;
    const p1 = 67;
    const p2 = 19;
    const phase2 = 1.2;

    const wobble1 = a1 * (p1 / TAU) * (1 - Math.cos((TAU * elapsedSec) / p1));
    const wobble2 = a2 * (p2 / TAU) * (
      Math.cos(phase2) - Math.cos((TAU * elapsedSec) / p2 + phase2)
    );

    return TOTAL_AT_ANCHOR + (BASE_PER_SEC * elapsedSec) + (BASE_PER_SEC * (wobble1 + wobble2));
  }

  function formatValue(n) {
    return Math.floor(n).toLocaleString("en-US");
  }

  function buildReel(startDigit) {
    const digitWrap = document.createElement("span");
    digitWrap.className = "token-digit";

    const reel = document.createElement("span");
    reel.className = "token-reel";

    for (let r = 0; r < 3; r++) {
      for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
        const cell = document.createElement("span");
        cell.className = "token-cell";
        cell.textContent = i;
        reel.appendChild(cell);
      }
    }

    digitWrap.appendChild(reel);
    const obj = { type: "digit", el: digitWrap, reel, digit: startDigit };
    setReelInstant(obj, startDigit);
    return obj;
  }

  function buildSeparator(char) {
    const sep = document.createElement("span");
    sep.className = "token-sep";
    sep.textContent = char;
    return { type: "sep", el: sep, char };
  }

  function setReelInstant(col, digit) {
    col.reel.style.transition = "none";
    col.reel.style.transform = "translateY(-" + ((10 + digit) * 1.05) + "em)";
    col.digit = digit;
  }

  function animateReel(col, targetDigit, duration, delay) {
    const currentDigit = col.digit;
    const steps = (targetDigit - currentDigit + 10) % 10;
    const targetIndex = 10 + currentDigit + steps;

    col.reel.style.transition = "none";
    col.reel.style.transform = "translateY(-" + ((10 + currentDigit) * 1.05) + "em)";

    requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      col.reel.style.transition = "transform " + duration + "ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) " + delay + "ms";
      col.reel.style.transform = "translateY(-" + (targetIndex * 1.05) + "em)";
    });

    setTimeout(() => {
      setReelInstant(col, targetDigit);
    }, duration + delay + 40);
  }

  function ensureStructure(str) {
    const shape = str.replace(/[0-9]/g, "0");
    const currentShape = columns.map(c => c.type === "digit" ? "0" : c.char).join("");

    if (columns.length && currentShape === shape) return;

    numberEl.innerHTML = "";
    columns = [];

    for (const ch of str) {
      if (/\d/.test(ch)) {
        const col = buildReel(Number(ch));
        columns.push(col);
        numberEl.appendChild(col.el);
      } else {
        const col = buildSeparator(ch);
        columns.push(col);
        numberEl.appendChild(col.el);
      }
    }
  }

  function setInstantValue(value) {
    const str = formatValue(value);
    ensureStructure(str);

    for (let i = 0; i < str.length; i++) {
      const ch = str[i];
      const col = columns[i];
      if (col && col.type === "digit" && /\d/.test(ch)) {
        setReelInstant(col, Number(ch));
      }
    }

    currentDisplayValue = Math.floor(value);
  }

  function animateToValue(value, duration) {
    const toStr = formatValue(value);
    ensureStructure(toStr);

    for (let i = 0; i < toStr.length; i++) {
      const ch = toStr[i];
      const col = columns[i];

      if (!col || col.type !== "digit" || !/\d/.test(ch)) continue;

      const placeFromRight = toStr.length - i - 1;
      const delay = Math.min(placeFromRight * 35, 180);
      animateReel(col, Number(ch), duration, delay);
    }

    currentDisplayValue = Math.floor(value);
  }

  function getCycle(nowMs) {
    const elapsedMs = Math.max(0, nowMs - ANCHOR_MS);
    const cycleIndex = Math.floor(elapsedMs / CYCLE_MS);
    const cycleStartMs = ANCHOR_MS + cycleIndex * CYCLE_MS;
    const cycleEndMs = cycleStartMs + CYCLE_MS;

    const animMs = MIN_ANIM_MS + hash01(cycleIndex) * (MAX_ANIM_MS - MIN_ANIM_MS);

    return {
      cycleIndex,
      animMs,
      startValue: integratedTotal((cycleStartMs - ANCHOR_MS) / 1000),
      endValue: integratedTotal((cycleEndMs - ANCHOR_MS) / 1000)
    };
  }

  function tick() {
    const nowMs = Date.now();
    const cycle = getCycle(nowMs);

    if (currentCycle === -1) {
      currentCycle = cycle.cycleIndex;
      setInstantValue(cycle.startValue);
    }

    if (cycle.cycleIndex !== currentCycle) {
      currentCycle = cycle.cycleIndex;
      setInstantValue(cycle.startValue);
      animateToValue(cycle.endValue, cycle.animMs);
    }

    requestAnimationFrame(tick);
  }

  const initial = getCycle(Date.now());
  currentCycle = initial.cycleIndex;
  setInstantValue(initial.startValue);
  animateToValue(initial.endValue, initial.animMs);

  requestAnimationFrame(tick);
})();

class="homeexp_gleansecure_logos-text">GDPR</div></div></div></div></div></div></section><section id="statistics" class="section_homeexp_stats"><div class="hide w-embed w-script"><style>
  [data-odometer-element] {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums !important;
    font-feature-settings: 'tnum' 1 !important;
  }
  [data-odometer-part='mask'],
  [data-odometer-part='static'] {
    display: inline-block;
    overflow: clip;
    padding: 0.05em;
    margin: -0.05em;
  }
  [data-odometer-part='roller'] {
    display: block;
    white-space: pre;
    text-align: center;
    will-change: transform;
  }
  [data-odometer-part='static'] {
    display: inline-block;
  }
</style>

<script>
  (function () {
    function start() {
      if (typeof gsap === 'undefined' || typeof ScrollTrigger === 'undefined') {
        console.warn('[odometer] GSAP or ScrollTrigger not loaded');
        return;
      }
      gsap.registerPlugin(ScrollTrigger);
      initNumberOdometer();
    }

    function initNumberOdometer() {
      const prefersReducedMotion = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
      const initFlag = 'data-odometer-initialized';

      const defaults = {
        duration: 1,
        ease: 'power3.out',
        elementStagger: 0.1,
        digitStagger: 0.04,
        revealDuration: 0.5,
        revealEase: 'power2.out',
        triggerStart: 'top 80%',
        staggerOrder: 'left',
        digitCycles: 2,
      };

      document.querySelectorAll('[data-odometer-group]').forEach((group) => {
        if (group.hasAttribute(initFlag)) return;
        group.setAttribute(initFlag, '');

        const elements = Array.from(group.querySelectorAll('[data-odometer-element]'));
        if (!elements.length || prefersReducedMotion) return;

        const staggerOrder = group.getAttribute('data-odometer-stagger-order') || defaults.staggerOrder;
        const triggerStart = group.getAttribute('data-odometer-trigger-start') || defaults.triggerStart;
        const elementStagger = parseFloat(group.getAttribute('data-odometer-stagger')) || defaults.elementStagger;

        const elementData = elements.map((el) => {
          const originalText = el.textContent.trim();

          el.setAttribute('aria-label', originalText);

          const hasExplicitStart = el.hasAttribute('data-odometer-start');
          const startValue = parseFloat(el.getAttribute('data-odometer-start')) || 0;
          const duration = parseFloat(el.getAttribute('data-odometer-duration')) || defaults.duration;
          const step = getLineHeightRatio(el);

          let segments = parseSegments(originalText);
          segments = mapStartDigits(segments, startValue);
          segments = markHiddenSegments(segments, startValue);

          const grow = shouldGrow(el, hasExplicitStart, startValue, segments);
          const { rollers, revealEls } = buildRollerDOM(el, segments, step, grow);

          const fontSize = parseFloat(getComputedStyle(el).fontSize);
          const revealData = revealEls.map((revealEl) => {
            const widthEm = revealEl.offsetWidth / fontSize;
            gsap.set(revealEl, { width: 0, overflow: 'hidden' });
            return { el: revealEl, widthEm };
          });

          return { el, rollers, duration, step, revealData, originalText };
        });

        const ordered = applyStaggerOrder(elementData, staggerOrder);

        const tl = gsap.timeline({
          scrollTrigger: { trigger: group, start: triggerStart, once: true },
          onComplete() {
            elementData.forEach(({ el, originalText }) => cleanupElement(el, originalText));
          },
        });

        ordered.forEach((data, orderIdx) => {
          const { rollers, duration, step, revealData } = data;
          const offset = orderIdx * elementStagger;

          revealData.forEach(({ el, widthEm }) => {
            tl.to(
              el,
              {
                width: widthEm + 'em',
                opacity: 1,
                duration: defaults.revealDuration,
                ease: defaults.revealEase,
              },
              offset,
            );
          });

          rollers.forEach(({ roller, targetPos }, digitIdx) => {
            const reversedIdx = rollers.length - 1 - digitIdx;
            tl.to(
              roller,
              {
                y: -targetPos * step + 'em',
                duration,
                ease: defaults.ease,
                force3D: true,
              },
              offset + reversedIdx * defaults.digitStagger,
            );
          });
        });
      });

      function getLineHeightRatio(el) {
        const cs = getComputedStyle(el);
        const lh = cs.lineHeight;
        if (lh === 'normal') return 1.2;
        return parseFloat(lh) / parseFloat(cs.fontSize);
      }
      function parseSegments(text) {
        return [...text].map((char) => ({ type: /\d/.test(char) ? 'digit' : 'static', char }));
      }
      function mapStartDigits(segments, startValue) {
        const digitSlots = segments.filter((s) => s.type === 'digit');
        const padded = String(Math.floor(Math.abs(startValue)))
          .padStart(digitSlots.length, '0')
          .slice(-digitSlots.length);
        let di = 0;
        return segments.map((s) => (s.type === 'digit' ? { ...s, startDigit: parseInt(padded[di++], 10) } : s));
      }
      function markHiddenSegments(segments, startValue) {
        const totalDigits = segments.filter((s) => s.type === 'digit').length;
        const absStart = Math.floor(Math.abs(startValue));
        const startDigitCount = absStart === 0 ? 1 : String(absStart).length;
        const leadingZeros = Math.max(0, totalDigits - startDigitCount);
        if (leadingZeros === 0) return segments;
        let digitsSeen = 0,
          firstDigitSeen = false,
          prevDigitHidden = false;
        return segments.map((seg) => {
          if (seg.type === 'digit') {
            firstDigitSeen = true;
            const hidden = digitsSeen < leadingZeros;
            prevDigitHidden = hidden;
            digitsSeen++;
            return { ...seg, hidden };
          }
          return { ...seg, hidden: firstDigitSeen && prevDigitHidden };
        });
      }
      function shouldGrow(el, hasExplicitStart, startValue, segments) {
        if (el.hasAttribute('data-odometer-grow')) {
          return el.getAttribute('data-odometer-grow') !== 'false';
        }
        if (!hasExplicitStart) return false;
        const absStart = Math.floor(Math.abs(startValue));
        const startDigitCount = absStart === 0 ? 1 : String(absStart).length;
        const endDigitCount = segments.filter((s) => s.type === 'digit').length;
        return startDigitCount < endDigitCount;
      }
      function buildRollerDOM(el, segments, step, grow) {
        el.innerHTML = '';
        el.style.height = '';
        const rollers = [],
          revealEls = [];
        const totalCells = 10 * defaults.digitCycles;
        segments.forEach((seg) => {
          if (seg.type === 'static') {
            const span = document.createElement('span');
            span.setAttribute('data-odometer-part', 'static');
            span.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
            span.style.height = step + 'em';
            span.style.lineHeight = step;
            span.textContent = seg.char;
            el.appendChild(span);
            if (grow && seg.hidden) {
              gsap.set(span, { opacity: 0 });
              revealEls.push(span);
            }
            return;
          }
          const mask = document.createElement('span');
          mask.setAttribute('data-odometer-part', 'mask');
          mask.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
          mask.style.height = step + 'em';
          mask.style.lineHeight = step;
          const roller = document.createElement('span');
          roller.setAttribute('data-odometer-part', 'roller');
          roller.style.lineHeight = step;
          const digits = [];
          for (let d = 0; d < totalCells; d++) digits.push(d % 10);
          roller.textContent = digits.join('\n');
          mask.appendChild(roller);
          el.appendChild(mask);
          const startDigit = seg.startDigit || 0;
          const isReveal = grow && seg.hidden;
          gsap.set(roller, { y: isReveal ? step + 'em' : -startDigit * step + 'em' });

<script>
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
  const items = document.querySelectorAll('.homeexp_customer_accordion_item');

  items.forEach((item, index) => {
    const header = item.querySelector('.homeexp_customer-accordion-header');
    const content = item.querySelector('.homeexp_accordion_content');

    // Give every header/content a UNIQUE id (your markup currently duplicates them)
    header.id = `accordion-header-${index + 1}`;
    content.id = `accordion-content-${index + 1}`;
    header.setAttribute('aria-controls', content.id);
    content.setAttribute('aria-labelledby', header.id);

    // Strip any leftover Webflow inline styles that fight the CSS
    content.style.removeProperty('display');
    content.style.removeProperty('height');

    // Open the first item by default
    if (index === 0) {
      item.classList.add('is-open');
      header.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
    } else {
      header.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
    }

    const toggle = () => {
      const wasOpen = item.classList.contains('is-open');

      // Close all
      items.forEach(other => {
        other.classList.remove('is-open');
        other.querySelector('.homeexp_customer-accordion-header')
             .setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
      });

      // Open this one if it wasn't already open
      if (!wasOpen) {
        item.classList.add('is-open');
        header.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
      }
    };

    header.addEventListener('click', toggle);
    header.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
      if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') {
        e.preventDefault();
        toggle();
      }
    });
  });
});

<script>
  function initPreviewFollower() {
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-follower-wrap]').forEach((wrap) => {
      const collection = wrap.querySelector('[data-follower-collection]');
      const items = wrap.querySelectorAll('[data-follower-item]');
      const follower = wrap.querySelector('[data-follower-cursor]');
      const followerInner = wrap.querySelector('[data-follower-cursor-inner]');
      let prevIndex = null;
      let firstEntry = true;
      const offset = 100;
      const duration = 0.5;
      const ease = 'power2.inOut';

      gsap.set(follower, { yPercent: -50 });
      const yTo = gsap.quickTo(follower, 'y', { duration: 0.6, ease: 'power3' });

      window.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
        const rect = wrap.getBoundingClientRect();
        yTo(e.clientY - rect.top);
      });

      items.forEach((item, index) => {
        item.addEventListener('mouseenter', () => {
          const forward = prevIndex === null || index > prevIndex;
          prevIndex = index;

          follower.querySelectorAll('[data-follower-visual]').forEach((el) => {
            gsap.killTweensOf(el);
            gsap.to(el, {
              yPercent: forward ? -offset : offset,
              duration,
              ease,
              overwrite: 'auto',
              onComplete: () => el.remove(),
            });
          });

          const visual = item.querySelector('[data-follower-visual]');
          if (!visual) return;
          const clone = visual.cloneNode(true);
          followerInner.appendChild(clone);

          if (!firstEntry) {
            gsap.fromTo(clone, { yPercent: forward ? offset : -offset }, { yPercent: 0, duration, ease, overwrite: 'auto' });
          } else {
            firstEntry = false;
          }
        });

        item.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => {
          const el = follower.querySelector('[data-follower-visual]');
          if (!el) return;
          gsap.killTweensOf(el);
          gsap.to(el, {
            yPercent: -offset,
            duration,
            ease,
            overwrite: 'auto',
            onComplete: () => el.remove(),
          });
        });
      });

      collection.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => {
        follower.querySelectorAll('[data-follower-visual]').forEach((el) => {
          gsap.killTweensOf(el);
          gsap.to(el, {
            yPercent: -offset,
            duration,
            ease,
            overwrite: 'auto',
            onComplete: () => el.remove(),
          });
        });
        firstEntry = true;
        prevIndex = null;
      });
    });
  }
  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', initPreviewFollower);

        var self = this;

          if (self.classList.contains('trigger-enter')) {
            self.classList.add('trigger-enter-active');

<script>
  (function () {
    // Match this to the width where your CSS switches from the mobile nav to the desktop nav.
    // Webflow's default desktop breakpoint is 992px.
    var desktopMQ = window.matchMedia('(min-width: 992px)');

    function closeMobileMenu() {
      var menu = document.getElementById('nav-mobile-menu');
      var sidePane = document.querySelector('.nav-25_mobile-menu_side-pane');

      // Kill any in-flight jQuery animations so they don't re-apply inline styles after we clear them
      if (window.jQuery) {
        jQuery('#nav-mobile-menu, .nav-25_mobile-menu_side-pane').stop(true, false);

      // Remove the inline styles the open handlers set, so CSS takes over again
      if (menu) {
        menu.style.removeProperty('display');

      }
      if (sidePane) {
        sidePane.style.removeProperty('display');
        sidePane.style.removeProperty('left');
        sidePane.style.removeProperty('opacity');
      }
    }

    function handleChange(e) {
      if (e.matches) closeMobileMenu(); // crossed into desktop

<script defer>
  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
    const input = document.getElementById('search-box');
    const container = document.getElementById('glean_search_component');
    if (!input) {
      // console.error('Missing #search-box element');
      return;
    }

    // Configure External Search backend + which sources to show in the modal
    const backend = 'https://glean-public-external-be.glean.com';
    const datasourcesFilter = [
      'glean',
      'blogs',
      'webjjldruagleancommunity',
      'web_7',
      'web_6',
      'web_8',
    ];

    let authProvider;

    // Fade-in helper: runs once attach is successful
    const showComponent = () => {
      if (!container) return;
      // Force reflow to ensure transition runs when we add the class
      container.offsetHeight;
      container.classList.add('is-visible');
    };

    // onAuthTokenRequired callback: must return a fresh token (Promise<string>)
    const refreshAuthToken = async () => {
      try {
        const token = await authProvider.createAuthToken();
        return token;
      } catch (err) {
        console.error('Failed to refresh auth token', err);
        return null;
      }
    };

    const attachWithToken = (authToken) => {
      if (!window.GleanWebSDK) {
        console.error('GleanWebSDK not available yet');
        return;
      }

      // Attach the modal to your input, with auto-auth + datasources + basic theming
      window.GleanWebSDK.attach(input, {
        backend,
        authToken,
        onAuthTokenRequired: refreshAuthToken,
        datasourcesFilter,
        enableActivityLogging: true,
        disableAssistant: true,
        chatOptions: false,
        searchBoxCustomizations: {
          placeholderText: 'Search',
          borderRadius: 4,
          fontSize: 14,
        },
        // Optional analytics hook:
        // onSearch: (query) => {
        //   console.log('Modal search:', query);
        // },
      });

      // Fade in only after the SDK is attached/initialized
      showComponent();
    };

    const init = async () => {
      try {
        if (!window.GleanWebSDK) {
          console.error('GleanWebSDK not ready in init()');
          return;
        }
        // Guest auth provider for External Search
        authProvider = window.GleanWebSDK.createGuestAuthProvider({ backend });
        const token = await authProvider.getAuthToken();
        if (!token) {
          console.error('Auth token was not fetched correctly.');
          return;
        }
        attachWithToken(token);
      } catch (err) {
        console.error('Initialization error:', err);
      }
    };

    // If SDK already loaded (e.g., cached), init immediately
    if (window.GleanWebSDK) {
      init();
      return;
    }

    // Otherwise, wait for the SDK to finish loading
    const sdkScript = document.querySelector(
      'script[src*="embedded-search-latest.min.js"]'
    );
    if (sdkScript) {
      // If the SDK dispatches a ready signal, listen for it
      window.addEventListener('glean:ready', () => init(), { once: true });

      // Fallback: if glean:ready isn’t dispatched, try init right after load
      sdkScript.addEventListener('load', () => {
        setTimeout(() => {
          if (window.GleanWebSDK) init();
        }, 0);
      });
    } else {
      console.error('Embedded Search SDK script tag not found');
    }
  });
</script>

<script>
(function () {
  /* =========================
     CONFIG
  ========================== */
  var SUPPORT_EMAIL = "hello@glean.com"; // change if needed
  var FALLBACK_COPY_TITLE = "Enable Targeted Advertising cookies to use this form";
  var FALLBACK_COPY_TEXT  = "To load and submit this Marketo form, please enable Targeted Advertising cookies in your preferences. You can turn them off again any time.";
  var CHECK_AFTER_MS = [800, 1600, 2800]; // covers slow loads + modal injection
  var HIDE_SCOPE = "embed"; // "embed" (recommended) or "form"

  // ✅ NEW: wait for Marketo if it loads late (cookies accepted but script slow)
  var WAIT_FOR_MKTO_MAX_MS = 20000;
  var WAIT_FOR_MKTO_EVERY_MS = 300;
  var __mktoWaitTimer = null;

  /* =========================
     HELPERS
  ========================== */
  function marketoLoaded() {
    return typeof window.MktoForms2 !== "undefined";
  }

  // ✅ NEW: start a single watcher that re-runs gating when MktoForms2 appears
  function waitForMarketoThenUngate() {
    if (__mktoWaitTimer || marketoLoaded()) return;

    var start = Date.now();
    __mktoWaitTimer = setInterval(function () {
      if (marketoLoaded()) {
        clearInterval(__mktoWaitTimer);
        __mktoWaitTimer = null;
        gateMktoFormsInDom(); // remove fallback + show forms
        return;
      }
      if (Date.now() - start > WAIT_FOR_MKTO_MAX_MS) {
        clearInterval(__mktoWaitTimer);
        __mktoWaitTimer = null;
      }
    }, WAIT_FOR_MKTO_EVERY_MS);
  }

  function escapeHtml(str) {
    return String(str)
      .replaceAll("&", "&")
      .replaceAll("<", "<")
      .replaceAll(">", ">")
      .replaceAll('"', """)
      .replaceAll("'", "'");
  }

  function ensureFallbackStyles() {
    if (document.getElementById("mkto-cookie-fallback-styles")) return;
    var style = document.createElement("style");
    style.id = "mkto-cookie-fallback-styles";
    style.textContent = `

        display:inline-flex;
        align-items:center;

        padding: 10px 14px;
        border-radius: 999px;
        border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.12);

        cursor:pointer;

        line-height: 1;
      }
      .mkto-cookie-fallback__btn--primary{
        background: #D8FD49;
        color: #111;
        border-color: transparent;
      }
      .mkto-cookie-fallback__btn--ghost{
        background: transparent;
        color: inherit;
      }
      .mkto-cookie-fallback__note{
        font-size: 12px;
        opacity: .7;
        margin-top: 10px;
      }
    `;
    document.head.appendChild(style);
  }

  function buildFallback() {
    var wrap = document.createElement("div");
    wrap.className = "mkto-cookie-fallback";
    wrap.innerHTML =
      '<div class="mkto-cookie-fallback__title">' + escapeHtml(FALLBACK_COPY_TITLE) + '</div>' +
      '<div class="mkto-cookie-fallback__text">' + escapeHtml(FALLBACK_COPY_TEXT) + '</div>' +
      '<div class="mkto-cookie-fallback__actions">' +
        '<a href="#" class="mkto-cookie-fallback__btn mkto-cookie-fallback__btn--primary" data-open-cookies="1">Manage cookies</a>' +
      '</div>' +
      '<div class="mkto-cookie-fallback__note">After you save preferences, this page will refresh to load the form.</div>';
    return wrap;
  }

  function getHideTargetForForm(formEl) {
    if (HIDE_SCOPE === "form") return formEl;
    // Most Marketo embeds are inside a Webflow embed wrapper:
    return formEl.closest("div.w-embed.w-script") || formEl;
  }

  /* =========================
     CORE: ONLY TARGET ACTUAL MARKETO FORMS
     - works for modals because MutationObserver triggers when form enters DOM
  ========================== */
  function gateMktoFormsInDom() {
    ensureFallbackStyles();

    var forms = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('form[id^="mktoForm_"]'));
    if (!forms.length) return; // ✅ prevents fallback anywhere else (e.g., navbar script embed)

    if (!marketoLoaded()) {
      // ✅ NEW: if Marketo loads late, we'll detect and ungate automatically
      waitForMarketoThenUngate();

      forms.forEach(function (formEl) {
        var target = getHideTargetForForm(formEl);

        if (!target.__mktoFallback) {
          var fb = buildFallback();
          target.insertAdjacentElement("beforebegin", fb);
          target.__mktoFallback = fb;
        }

        target.style.display = "none";
      });
    } else {
      forms.forEach(function (formEl) {
        var target = getHideTargetForForm(formEl);

        target.style.display = "";
        if (target.__mktoFallback) {
          target.__mktoFallback.remove();
          target.__mktoFallback = null;
        }
      });
    }
  }

  /* =========================
     OSANO: open drawer + reload on Save
     (based on your DOM: .osano-cm-save exists)
  ========================== */
  var reloadInFlight = false;
  function reloadSoon() {
    if (reloadInFlight) return;
    reloadInFlight = true;
    setTimeout(function () { window.location.reload(); }, 200);
  }

  function openOsanoDrawer() {
    if (window.Osano && window.Osano.cm && typeof window.Osano.cm.showDrawer === "function") {
      window.Osano.cm.showDrawer();
      return true;
    }
    // fallback: click widget / manage button
    var btn = document.querySelector(".osano-cm-widget, .osano-cm-manage, .osano-cm-button--type_manage");
    if (btn) { btn.click(); return true; }
    return false;
  }

  // Reload when user saves preferences in drawer
  document.addEventListener("click", function (e) {
    var t = e.target;

    if (t.closest && t.closest(".osano-cm-save")) {
      reloadSoon();
      return;
    }

    // optional: if your setup persists on close/accept/reject
    if (t.closest && (
      t.closest(".osano-cm-accept") ||
      t.closest(".osano-cm-deny") ||
      t.closest(".osano-cm-reject") ||
      t.closest(".osano-cm-close")
    )) {
      setTimeout(reloadSoon, 250);
      return;
    }
  }, true);

  // Fallback button → open drawer
  document.addEventListener("click", function (e) {
    var btn = e.target.closest && e.target.closest("[data-open-cookies]");
    if (!btn) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    openOsanoDrawer();
  });

  /* =========================
     INIT
  ========================== */
  window.addEventListener("load", function () {
    CHECK_AFTER_MS.forEach(function (ms) {
      setTimeout(gateMktoFormsInDom, ms);
    });
  });

  // ✅ This solves “not in DOM yet” (modals):
  // When the modal opens and Webflow injects the form placeholder into the DOM,
  // the observer fires and we run gating immediately.
  var obs = new MutationObserver(function () {
    clearTimeout(window.__mktoGateT);
    window.__mktoGateT = setTimeout(gateMktoFormsInDom, 150);
  });
  obs.observe(document.documentElement, { childList: true, subtree: true });

})();
</script>

<!-- Add /fr and /jp to internal links on secondary locale -->
<script>
(function () {
  var locales = ["fr", "jp"];
  var internalHosts = ["www.glean.com", "glean.com"];

  var parts = location.pathname.split("/");
  var locale = locales.indexOf(parts[1]) !== -1 ? parts[1] : null;
  if (!locale) return;

  var prefix = "/" + locale;

  function hasLocale(path) {
    for (var i = 0; i < locales.length; i++) {
      var p = "/" + locales[i];
      if (path === p || path.startsWith(p + "/")) return true;
    }
    return false;
  }

  function localize(link) {
    var raw = link.getAttribute("href");
    if (!raw || raw.startsWith("#") || /^(mailto:|tel:|javascript:)/i.test(raw)) return;

    var url;
    try { url = new URL(raw, location.href); } catch (e) { return; }

    if (!internalHosts.includes(url.hostname)) return;
    if (hasLocale(url.pathname)) return;
    if (/\.(pdf|png|jpe?g|svg|webp|gif|zip)$/i.test(url.pathname)) return;

    link.setAttribute("href", prefix + url.pathname + url.search + url.hash);
  }

  function run() {
    document.querySelectorAll("a[href]").forEach(localize);
  }

  var timer;
  function scheduleRun() {
    clearTimeout(timer);
    timer = setTimeout(run, 150);
  }

  if (document.readyState === "loading") {
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", run);
  } else {
    run();
  }

  new MutationObserver(function (mutations) {
    for (var i = 0; i < mutations.length; i++) {
      if (mutations[i].addedNodes.length) {
        scheduleRun();
        return;
      }
    }
  }).observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
})();
</script>

<script>
(function () {
  'use strict';
  document.documentElement.classList.add('motion-ready');

  const TOTAL_TIMEOUT_MS = 2500;
  const PLUGIN_GRACE_MS  = 500;
  const POLL_INTERVAL_MS = 80;

  function waitForGsap(onReady, onTimeout) {
    const start = performance.now();
    let gsapReadyAt = null;

    const tick = setInterval(function () {
      const now = performance.now();
      const hasGsap  = typeof window.gsap !== 'undefined';
      const hasST    = typeof window.ScrollTrigger !== 'undefined';
      const hasSplit = typeof window.SplitText !== 'undefined';

      if (hasGsap && gsapReadyAt === null) gsapReadyAt = now;

      if (hasGsap && hasST && hasSplit) {
        clearInterval(tick);
        return onReady(window.gsap, window.ScrollTrigger, window.SplitText);
      }
      if (hasGsap && (now - gsapReadyAt) > PLUGIN_GRACE_MS) {
        clearInterval(tick);
        if (!hasST)    console.warn('[motion] ScrollTrigger not detected — scroll/scrub variants disabled.');
        if (!hasSplit) console.warn('[motion] SplitText not detected — split-* falls back to fade-up.');
        return onReady(window.gsap, window.ScrollTrigger, window.SplitText);
      }
      if (now - start > TOTAL_TIMEOUT_MS) {
        clearInterval(tick);
        return onTimeout();
      }
    }, POLL_INTERVAL_MS);
  }

  function gracefulFallback() {
    document.documentElement.classList.remove('motion-ready');
    console.warn(
      '[motion] GSAP not found on window after ' + TOTAL_TIMEOUT_MS + 'ms — content revealed without animation.\n' +
      'ES module setup? Expose globally:\n' +
      '  window.gsap = gsap; window.ScrollTrigger = ScrollTrigger; window.SplitText = SplitText;'
    );
  }

  waitForGsap(boot, gracefulFallback);

  function boot(gsap, ScrollTrigger, SplitText) {
    if (ScrollTrigger) gsap.registerPlugin(ScrollTrigger);
    if (SplitText) gsap.registerPlugin(SplitText);

    const DEFAULTS = {
      duration: 0.9,
      ease: 'expo.out',
      start: 'top 85%',
      end: 'bottom 50%',
      stagger: 0.1,
      splitStagger: { lines: 0.08, words: 0.04, chars: 0.015 },
      splitDuration: 1.0,
      scrubStart: 'top 80%',
      scrubEnd: 'bottom 50%',
      scrubSmoothing: 0.5,
      fadedAlpha: 0.22,
    };

    const VARIANTS = {
      'fade':       { opacity: 0 },
      'fade-up':    { opacity: 0, y: 32 },
      'fade-down':  { opacity: 0, y: -32 },
      'fade-left':  { opacity: 0, x: -32 },
      'fade-right': { opacity: 0, x: 32 },
      'scale':      { opacity: 0, scale: 0.94 },
      'blur':       { opacity: 0, filter: 'blur(10px)' },
    };

    const TO_NEUTRAL = { opacity: 1, y: 0, x: 0, scale: 1, filter: 'blur(0px)' };
    const reduceMotion = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;

    function clearWillChange(target) {
      if (!target) return;
      if (target.style) target.style.willChange = 'auto';
      else if (target.length) {
        for (let i = 0; i < target.length; i++) target[i].style.willChange = 'auto';
      }
    }

    function toFaded(cssColor, alpha) {
      const m = cssColor.match(/\d+(\.\d+)?/g);
      if (!m || m.length < 3) return 'rgba(0, 0, 0, ' + alpha + ')';
      return 'rgba(' + m[0] + ', ' + m[1] + ', ' + m[2] + ', ' + alpha + ')';
    }

    function prepSplit(el, type) {
      if (!SplitText) {
        console.warn('[motion] SplitText not loaded — "split-' + type + '" falls back to fade-up.');
        return null;
      }
      if (!el.hasAttribute('aria-label')) {
        el.setAttribute('aria-label', el.textContent.trim());
      }
      const split = SplitText.create(el, {
        type: type, mask: type,
        autoSplit: type === 'lines',
        linesClass: 'motion-line',
        wordsClass: 'motion-word',
        charsClass: 'motion-char',
        onSplit: type === 'lines' ? function (self) {
          gsap.set(self.lines, { yPercent: el.dataset.animPlayed === '1' ? 0 : 100 });
        } : undefined,
      });
      gsap.set(split[type], { yPercent: 100 });
      gsap.set(el, { opacity: 1 });
      el._motionSplit = split;
      return split;
    }

    function setupScrub(el, variant) {
      const ds = el.dataset;
      const computedTo = getComputedStyle(el).color;
      const toColor    = ds.animTo   || computedTo;
      const fromColor  = ds.animFrom || toFaded(computedTo, DEFAULTS.fadedAlpha);
      const start      = ds.animStart || DEFAULTS.scrubStart;
      const end        = ds.animEnd   || DEFAULTS.scrubEnd;
      const stagger    = parseFloat(ds.animStagger) || 0.1;
      const smoothing  = parseFloat(ds.animSmoothing) || DEFAULTS.scrubSmoothing;

      if (variant === 'scrub-words') {
        if (!SplitText) {
          console.warn('[motion] SplitText needed for scrub-words — falling back to scrub-color.', el);
        } else {

            el.setAttribute('aria-label', el.textContent.trim());
          }
          SplitText.create(el, {
            type: 'words',
            wordsClass: 'motion-word',
            autoSplit: true,
            onSplit: function (self) {
              gsap.set(self.words, { color: fromColor });
              return gsap.to(self.words, {
                color: toColor, ease: 'none', stagger: stagger,
                scrollTrigger: { trigger: el, start: start, end: end, scrub: smoothing, invalidateOnRefresh: true },
              });
            },
          });
          gsap.set(el, { opacity: 1 });
          return;
        }
      }

      gsap.set(el, { color: fromColor, opacity: 1 });
      gsap.to(el, {
        color: toColor, ease: 'none',
        scrollTrigger: { trigger: el, start: start, end: end, scrub: smoothing },
      });
    }

    function setupParallax(el) {
      const ds = el.dataset;
      const distance  = parseFloat(ds.animDistance) || -10;
      const smoothing = parseFloat(ds.animSmoothing) || DEFAULTS.scrubSmoothing;
      const start = ds.animStart || 'top bottom';
      const end   = ds.animEnd   || 'bottom top';

      gsap.set(el, { opacity: 1 });
      gsap.to(el, {
        yPercent: distance, ease: 'none',
        scrollTrigger: { trigger: el, start: start, end: end, scrub: smoothing, invalidateOnRefresh: true },
      });
    }

    function animate(el) {
      const ds = el.dataset;
      const variant = ds.anim;
      const delay = parseFloat(ds.animDelay) || 0;

      if (variant && variant.indexOf('split-') === 0) {
        const type = variant.replace('split-', '');
        const split = el._motionSplit;
        if (!split) {
          return gsap.fromTo(el, VARIANTS['fade-up'], {
            ...TO_NEUTRAL, duration: DEFAULTS.duration, delay: delay, ease: DEFAULTS.ease,
            onComplete: function () { clearWillChange(el); },
          });
        }
        const duration = parseFloat(ds.animDuration) || DEFAULTS.splitDuration;
        const stagger = parseFloat(ds.animStagger) || DEFAULTS.splitStagger[type];
        ds.animPlayed = '1';
        return gsap.to(split[type], {
          yPercent: 0, duration: duration, delay: delay, ease: DEFAULTS.ease, stagger: stagger, overwrite: 'auto',
          onComplete: function () { clearWillChange(el); },
        });
      }

      const duration = parseFloat(ds.animDuration) || DEFAULTS.duration;

      if (variant === 'stagger') {
        const stagger = parseFloat(ds.animStagger) || DEFAULTS.stagger;
        if (!el.children.length) return;
        const kids = el.children;
        return gsap.fromTo(
          kids,
          { opacity: 0, y: 24 },
          { ...TO_NEUTRAL, duration: duration, delay: delay, ease: DEFAULTS.ease, stagger: stagger, overwrite: 'auto',
            onComplete: function () { clearWillChange(kids); } }
        );
      }

      const from = VARIANTS[variant] || VARIANTS['fade-up'];
      return gsap.fromTo(el, from, {
        ...TO_NEUTRAL, duration: duration, delay: delay, ease: DEFAULTS.ease, overwrite: 'auto',
        onComplete: function () { clearWillChange(el); },
      });
    }

    function init(root) {
      root = root || document;
      const els = root.querySelectorAll('[data-anim]:not([data-anim-bound])');
      if (!els.length) return;

      for (let i = 0; i < els.length; i++) {
        const el = els[i];
        el.setAttribute('data-anim-bound', '');
        const variant = el.dataset.anim;

        if (reduceMotion) {
          gsap.set(el, { clearProps: 'all' });
          continue;
        }

        if (variant && variant.indexOf('scrub-') === 0) {
          if (!ScrollTrigger) {
            console.warn('[motion] ScrollTrigger required for scrub variants.');
            gsap.set(el, { opacity: 1 });
            continue;
          }
          setupScrub(el, variant);
          continue;
        }

        if (variant === 'parallax') {
          if (!ScrollTrigger) {
            console.warn('[motion] ScrollTrigger required for parallax.');
            gsap.set(el, { opacity: 1 });
            continue;
          }
          setupParallax(el);
          continue;
        }

        if (variant && variant.indexOf('split-') === 0) {
          prepSplit(el, variant.replace('split-', ''));
        }

        const trigger = el.dataset.animOn || 'scroll';
        if (trigger === 'load') {
          animate(el);
        } else if (ScrollTrigger) {
          (function (target) {
            ScrollTrigger.create({
              trigger: target,
              start: target.dataset.animStart || DEFAULTS.start,
              once: true,
              onEnter: function () { animate(target); },
            });
          })(el);
        } else {
          console.warn('[motion] ScrollTrigger not loaded — firing on load instead of scroll.');
          animate(el);
        }
      }

    let refreshTimer;
    function debouncedRefresh() {
      clearTimeout(refreshTimer);
      refreshTimer = setTimeout(function () { if (ScrollTrigger) ScrollTrigger.refresh(); }, 150);
    }

    window.Motion = {
      init: init,
      animate: animate,
      refresh: debouncedRefresh,

    } else {

    }

    }

  }

    var els = document.querySelectorAll('[' + attr + ']');
    for (var i = 0; i < els.length; i++) {
      if (els[i] !== rail && !rail.contains(els[i])) return els[i];
    }
    return null;
  }

  var pairs = [];
  Array.prototype.forEach.call(rail.querySelectorAll('a[href^="#"]'), function (row) {
    var section = findEl(row.getAttribute('href'));
    if (!section) { row.style.display = 'none'; return; }
    pairs.push({
      row: row, section: section,
      icon: row.querySelector('.sidenav_icon'),
      label: row.querySelector('.sidenav_label')
    });
  });
  if (!pairs.length) { console.warn('[sidenav] no rows resolved'); return; }

  var labels = pairs.map(function (p) { return p.label; }).filter(Boolean);

  gsap.set(rail, { autoAlpha: 0, x: -16 });
  gsap.set(labels, { width: 0, opacity: 0, marginLeft: 0, overflow: 'hidden' });

  pairs.forEach(function (p, i) {
    ScrollTrigger.create({
      trigger: p.section, start: 'top 50%', end: 'bottom 50%',
      onEnter: function () { setActive(i); },
      onEnterBack: function () { setActive(i); }
    });

    p.row.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
      e.preventDefault();
      e.stopPropagation();   // keeps Webflow's smooth scroll from fighting GSAP
      gsap.to(window, {
        duration: still ? 0 : 0.9, ease: 'power2.inOut',

      p.section.focus({ preventScroll: true });
    });
  });

  function setActive(n) {
    pairs.forEach(function (p, i) {
      var on = i === n;
      p.row.classList.toggle('is-active', on);
      if (p.icon) p.icon.classList.toggle('is-active', on);
      if (p.label) p.label.classList.toggle('is-active', on);

         : p.row.removeAttribute('aria-current');

    return a.section.compareDocumentPosition(b.section) & 4 ? -1 : 1;
  });

  var startEl = marked('data-nav-start')
                || findEl(rail.getAttribute('data-nav-start'))
                || order[0].section;

  var endEl   = marked('data-nav-end')
                || findEl(rail.getAttribute('data-nav-end'))
                || order[order.length - 1].section;

  function at(el, attr, fallback) {
    return (el && el.getAttribute(attr)) || rail.getAttribute(attr) || fallback;
  }

  var reveal = gsap.to(rail, {
    autoAlpha: 1, x: 0, duration: still ? 0 : 0.45, ease: 'power2.out', paused: true
  });

  ScrollTrigger.create({
    trigger:    startEl,
    endTrigger: endEl,
    start:      at(startEl, 'data-nav-start-at', 'top 80%'),
    end:        at(endEl,   'data-nav-end-at',   'bottom 80%'),
    onToggle:   function (self) { self.isActive ? reveal.play() : reveal.reverse(); }
  });

  var open = gsap.to(labels, {
    width: 'auto', opacity: 1, marginLeft: GAP,
    duration: still ? 0 : 0.3, ease: 'power2.out', stagger: 0.02, paused: true
  });

  rail.addEventListener('mouseenter', function () { open.play(); });
  rail.addEventListener('mouseleave', function () { open.reverse(); });
  rail.addEventListener('focusin', function () { open.play(); });
  rail.addEventListener('focusout', function (e) {
    if (!rail.contains(e.relatedTarget)) open.reverse();
  });

  ScrollTrigger.refresh();
  window.addEventListener('load', function () { ScrollTrigger.refresh(); });
})();
